measurement.observed_useful_span_definition: last_meaningful_progress_at - substantive_work_started_at; diagnostic only until internal evidence-gap audit passes
measurement.continuous_progress_rule: Only spans whose durable evidence-point gaps all satisfy the <=120s contract may be promoted to counted useful span.
measurement.window_useful_coverage_definition: sum of evidenced useful intervals inside the intended observation window, excluding unexplained gaps and known idle/waiting
measurement.target_operating_model: >=840s evidenced useful coverage per intended 900s evaluation window
measurement.scheduler_migration_note: Fixed-quarter feasibility arithmetic is historical after activation of the rolling completion-relative RRULE lifecycle. New production observations must measure actual wake, work, final rearm, next wake, and unexplained evidence gaps rather than assuming a quarter boundary.

meaningful_outputs: wake architecture migrated from fixed-quarter active layer to rolling RRULE active layer
active_turn_observation.note: This is the first production observation under the rolling lifecycle. Do not combine it statistically with fixed-quarter windows until the measurement model is explicitly normalized.

latest_completed_turn.reason: Valid historical fixed-quarter evidence retained for comparison, but scheduler topology has changed and this turn is not counted as a rolling-lifecycle acceptance sample.

latest_diagnosis.evidence: Controlled same-canonical two-wake canary disproved the earlier assumption that RRULE DTSTART self-shift could not provide fast reentry. Production policy now uses provisional +13m rescue and completion-relative +1m final rearm.
latest_diagnosis.secondary_risk: A canary does not prove long-turn production behavior. The first production wake must prove final rearm, automatic next wake, no rollback, and acceptable gap under real work.

next_corrective_experiment.hypothesis: Rolling same-canonical RRULE lifecycle removes fixed-quarter scheduler-budget loss while retaining bounded cold rescue.
next_corrective_experiment.change: At each valid wake provisionally arm +13m before work, sustain useful work near 10m, checkpoint, final-rearm same canonical to close+1m, and measure the actual next wake/gap.
next_corrective_experiment.success_signal: At least one production cycle proves expected wake -> provisional arm -> sustained work/checkpoint -> close+1m final rearm -> automatic same-canonical next wake with no stale rollback/duplicate overlap; then collect three normalized rolling samples for the utilization acceptance gate.
